QUOTE: With the opt-out: the same token becomes `ctx.nr`, the real field name. ... Default (opt-out not set): `ctx.MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` becomes `ctx.private_nr`. The field is renamed in the public header, so user code that touches it fails to compile.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that code defining the opt-out sees plain member names, while default consumers of the public headers see the renamed `private_` names.
